name: ModelVariant668_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant668_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a spinning shell of eight petals, each a strip of Gouraud-shaded bands, with a sprite at its centre, swells from a model point while a screen flash fades); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-685 images and the Spanish model-447 raw images 109772/109782 build the same source through french_model_variant/variant685_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x28 lower; the Japanese slot-1 image keeps its MODEL668_STRING_PAD selector. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
